verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own event-driven automation: custom approval chains that automate multi-step HR processes like equipment requests or off-boarding, an automated hire-to-onboard flow, and Payroll AI that spots timesheet inconsistencies and texts the admin. However, nothing shows a general user-defined rule builder with configurable triggers and actions. Auto payroll is schedule-based, and the Workforce API webhooks are a developer building block, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable trigger/condition/action rule engine, a choice of event types and actions, AI-assisted rule authoring, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
